title:
This is the example deck: one scene per building block.
Press → to fly to the next scene, O for the overview.
cards:
Three moves: fly, build, dive.
[PRESS] fly
[PRESS] build
[PRESS] dive
number:
<BigNumber> counts as the scene arrives, ring in sync.
Come back to it: it counts again.
[PRESS] the punchline
code:
<Code> with per-step line focus and callouts.
[PRESS] the scenes
[PRESS] the nest token
diagram:
<Diagram> from arch.js, one box per click; then → rides a wire in.
[PRESS] the deck
[PRESS] the engine (and its slot)
[PRESS] the browser, packets start
[PRESS] /notes, synced
inside:
We rode the scenes packet into the engine box: a nested scene.
[PRESS] nest()
[PRESS] builds
Next → rides the render wire out to the browser.
canvas:
Inside the browser: every scene on one element.
[PRESS] the camera is one CSS transform
[PRESS] the ride was that transform, following the wire
screens:
Two tilted <Shot> placeholders.
Drop PNGs in public/shots/ to fill them.
live:
A real, clickable site in a frame.
Move the mouse off it to drive the deck again.
X jumps to the fallback if it dies.
loop:
A small looping SVG, drawn in the scene.
Colours come from the theme tokens.
deeper:
One card, four presses deeper. Things appear as we get close.
[PRESS] a component
[PRESS] a line of code
[PRESS] one character
[PRESS] its dot: the title scene. Scenes all the way down.
takeaway:
Ghost scene: hovers over the whole canvas.
(pause) Every scene is a file you can copy.
fallback:
Skipped by → and ←; X jumps here.
Screenshots of the demo, in case it dies.
thanks:
Thanks!
Copy decks/example to start your own.
